cmqwkg8ex01wtnwqo23jtljun.overview: The Water and Waste Management Technician program covers the principles of water resource management, waste treatment, and environmental protection. Ideal for those passionate about sustainability, students engage in hands-on learning and develop critical thinking skills. Graduates are prepared to address the challenges of water and waste management in various settings, contributing to a healthier environment.
cmqwkg8ex01wtnwqo23jtljun.entry: Applicants must be in the final year of high school or already graduated. Applications are evaluated against the exams, diplomas and minimum scores in the university's international admission directive (Annex 1) and the quotas; meeting the requirements does not guarantee admission. High-school leaving exams recognised by YÖK (Abitur, IB, GCE, Tawjihi, etc.) have no validity limit; university entrance exams such as the SAT are valid for two years. Programmes that admit by special talent exam also require the university's talent exam. Associate and bachelor's admission is for the Fall semester only.
